# `morphir kb decision show`

- **Usage:** `morphir kb decision show [FLAGS] [ID]`

Show one decision record

## Arguments
- **`[ID]`** — Decision id or slug, e.g. 0004

## Flags
- **`--kb <PATH>`** — Path to the knowledge base root (the directory holding bundles/). Auto-detected when omitted
- **`--json`** — Emit JSON instead of text, for chaining and for agent consumption
- **`--bundle <BUNDLE>`** — Bundle to look in — required when an id means a record in more than one
- **`--body`** — Also include the document body
